name: ai-governance-legal
description: AI use-case triage, impact assessments, vendor AI reviews, and policy tracking for legal and compliance teams managing AI risk.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial practice profile setup — learns your AI inventory, applicable frameworks, and governance structure in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: use-case-triage
skills.description: Assess a described AI use case against applicable legal frameworks and your internal risk tiers — outputs a risk rating and required next steps

skills.name: aia-generation
skills.description: Generate an AI impact assessment (AIA) or algorithmic impact assessment document for a specified use case

skills.name: vendor-ai-review
skills.description: Review a vendor's AI system documentation, model cards, and contractual representations against your AI procurement standards

skills.name: policy-tracker
skills.description: Track the status of AI legislation, regulatory guidance, and standards (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, state laws) relevant to your operations
